title: TIMA: Text-Image Mutual Awareness for Balancing Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness and Generalization Ability
abstract: arXiv:2405.17678v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Achieving zero-shot adversarial robustness without sacrificing generalization remains challenging for foundation models such as CLIP, especially under large adversarial perturbations. Through empirical analyses, we identify three critical yet overlooked issues: (1) Logit margins exhibit a stable offset between small and large adversarial perturbations, suggesting that explicitly adjusting margins could improve robustness against unseen large perturbations. (2) A significant negative correlation exists between logit margin and inter-class semantic similarity, indicating that semantic structures are insufficiently leveraged by existing methods. (3) Existing methods for adjusting text embeddings disrupt the intrinsic semantic consistency established by pre-trained models, undermining generalization capability. Motivated by these findings, we propose a novel Text-Image Mutual Awareness (TIMA) framework, including a Text-Aware Image

translated_title: TIMA：文本-图像相互感知，用于平衡零样本对抗鲁棒性与泛化能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2405.17678v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：在不牺牲泛化能力的情况下实现零样本对抗鲁棒性，对于像CLIP这样的基础模型仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在大对抗扰动下。通过实证分析，我们识别出三个关键但被忽视的问题：（1）逻辑余量在小和大对抗扰动之间表现出稳定的偏移，这表明显式调整余量可以提高对未见的大扰动的鲁棒性。（2）逻辑余量与类间语义相似性之间存在显著的负相关，这表明现有方法未能充分利用语义结构。（3）现有调整文本嵌入的方法破坏了预训练模型建立的内在语义一致性，从而削弱了泛化能力。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种新颖的文本-图像相互感知（TIMA）框架，包括一个文本感知的图像模块。
tldr: 提出TIMA框架，通过调整逻辑余量、利用语义相似性并保持文本嵌入的语义一致性，平衡零样本对抗鲁棒性与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: The TIMA framework balances zero-shot adversarial robustness and generalization by adjusting logit margins, leveraging semantic similarity, and preserving semantic consistency in text embeddings.
